basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old graphic designer from Austin, Texas, with a newfound love for collecting Funko Pops. My wife and I started this hobby together after stumbling upon a rare pop at a local convention. I'm usually online during late evenings, after work. I enjoy gaming, particularly Fortnite, and I’m an avid fan of Magic: The Gathering. I'm currently married and enjoy spending my weekends at local comic book stores or gaming with friends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in visual arts with a degree in Graphic Design. My interest in technology and collectibles is largely self-taught, fueled by online communities and forums. I have recently been learning about computer vision using libraries like OpenCV, primarily to enhance my graphic design projects.
